Begin your answer with exactly one line: "Verdict: yes", "Verdict: no", or "Verdict: cannot tell from this trace". Then answer the question.
answer:
Verdict: no

Across the trace (0–30,589.6 ms), the measured highest-CPU crunch threads did not use a full CPU while waiting. For example, calc-3 (TID 636899) used CPU for 10.2% of the trace and at most 13.6% in its busiest 100 ms window; it spent 69.0% of that window waiting for a CPU and 17.4% blocked in futex calls. Those futex waits are synchronization waits, likely for work or a result—not time spent consuming CPU. The analysis checked five top CPU-share candidates, not every crunch thread.
